title: Water queue hygiene and fairness station
summary: A small-system procedure for water distribution lines so containers stay clean, vulnerable people are not pushed aside, and arguments do not stop the supply point.
content: Core sequence: 1) Separate dirty empty containers from filled clean containers with a visible line or table. 2) Create a priority lane for people who cannot stand long, caregivers with infants, and urgent medical water needs. 3) Cap each container immediately after filling and mark date, source, and whether treatment is still required. 4) Use a written turn list when tempers rise instead of letting the loudest person control the queue.
